# 🧩 YesCaptcha

> **Category**: `CAPTCHA Solver`  
> **Official Vendor API Docs**: [https://docs.yescaptcha.com](https://docs.yescaptcha.com)

Multi-CAPTCHA recognition API: reCAPTCHA v2/v3/Enterprise, hCaptcha, Turnstile, FunCaptcha, and AWS WAF.
